observed: The single authorized combined batch exceeded the external 654040 ms execution limit without returning Bun's pass/fail summary.
The batch process remained alive with an ACL-tool child and console-host descendant until explicit termination.
No typed AppContainer failure envelope was available, so the exact stage, invariant, native phase/code, and cleanup chain remain unknown.
blockers.impact: The repaired implementation has no promotable dynamic owner-batch evidence. Typecheck and all downstream gates are invalid to start, and the branch cannot be committed or published as a candidate.
blockers.requiredResolution: Freeze a new bounded verification package before any retry. Its outer watchdog and streaming evidence capture must be independent of the per-test timeout, and static review must first decide whether the surviving ACL-tool process represents a lifecycle defect or only an interrupted synchronous host probe. Do not infer an AppContainer root cause from this timeout record.

resumeBoundary: Do not rerun the 39-file batch or an individual test under this frozen Work Package.
